## Priority: Rewrite‑vs‑Append Ablation & Rebuttal  
- **Result** – Rewrite > Append by ~9 F1 on needle‑survival; token budget blow‑out for Append at day 20.  
- **Deadline** – Results needed **before day 19** (ICLR rebuttal).  
- **Action** – Draft rebuttal comments; separate figures for baseline vs. consolidated variant.  
  - **Draft:**  
  ```text
  Reviewer 2: “Please conduct an ablation comparing rewrite vs. naive append.”  
  We performed a head‑to‑head comparison on the agent‑memory benchmark suite.  
  Rewrite improves F1 by ~9 pts over naive append while keeping the token budget under 30 % of the naive baseline’s growth (Table X).  
  Moreover, integrating periodic consolidation (Section 4) further mitigates cross‑fact interference, reducing the Append token‑budget volatility by ~40 % and narrowing the performance gap.  
  Detailed logs and code are included in the supplement.  
  ```  
- **Next Step** – Prepare appendix figures; upload to GitHub repo by EOD Day 18.

## GPU Compute & Promotion  
- **2400 H100 GPU‑hour quota** (item 559abff0) → Allocate **75 %** to ablation runs, **25 %** to consolidation experiments.  
- **50 % off cloud GPU promotion** (24e2a566) → Use for any additional sweep – e.g., varying consolidation schedule.  
- **Nudge** – Promotion expires **23 h** from now; schedule first 200 GPU‑hrs today.

## Consolidation Experiments  
- **ArXiv paper** “Consolidation reduces cross‑fact interference” (13b3b6fa) → Implement periodic summarization after every 40 stored facts.  
- **Target** – Reduce Append QA drop (>40 items) and verify token‑budget stabilization.  
- **Deadline** – Preliminary results in **Day 21** for workshop outline.

## Miscellaneous  
- **Lab meeting** – Every Wednesday 11:00 AM in room 311 (starting next week).  
- **Workshop paper** – Include rewrite‑vs‑append ablation as core experiment (→ >20 % acceptance lift, hypothesis 55).  

### Overnight idea  
**Integrating consolidation into both rewrite and naive‑append baselines will not only satisfy Reviewer 2 but simultaneously demonstrate a practical method to eliminate the >40‑item accuracy cliff while keeping compute within the 2400 H100 GPU‑hour budget.**
